description: Demonstrates error detection, retry logic, and fallback routing when an agent fails.

agents.name: Primary Data Fetcher
agents.prompt: Fetch and summarize the requested data: {{query}}. If unable to retrieve, output exactly: ERROR: unable to fetch.

agents.name: Fallback Agent
agents.prompt: The primary data source failed. Use alternative approach to answer: {{query}}. Acknowledge you are using a fallback source.

agents.name: Summary Writer
agents.prompt: Summarize the following response in 2-3 sentences: {{primary_agent}}{{fallback_agent}}

initial_state.query: What are the latest sales figures for Q4?
